'''Anno Wen-Chii''' was a reclusive [[Pyn'gani]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who lived near the end of the [[New Sith Wars]]. In [[995 BBY]], [[Gender/Legends|he]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Nalia Adollu]], went to his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], [[Polus]], to study life-forms; they were not seen on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] for the next [[990 BBY|five years]]. Wen-Chii was a good friend of the [[Lore Keeper|Jedi librarian]] [[Barra-Rona-Ban]], with whom they had studied together.

==Biography==
Anno Wen-Chii was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Pyn'gani]] from the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Polus]] who lived around the end of the [[New Sith Wars]]. Wen-Chii was discovered and [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], eventually reaching the rank of a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] before [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]]. Sometime during his life as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], he studied with his friend, the [[Lore Keeper|Jedi librarian]] [[Barra-Rona-Ban]] and they visited Polus together. After the [[Ruusan campaign|Battle of Ruusan]], Wen-Chii took the [[Human/Legends|Human]] female [[Nalia Adollu]] as his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] and chose to eke out a simple life on his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. Having returned to Polus in [[995 BBY]], Wen-Chii studied the native [[Species/Legends|species]], hoping to find out how life had evolved in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and how it continued to evolve through thousands of [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. The at least five-year absence of him and his Padawan from the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] allowed the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]] to use the name of Adollu to infiltrate the Temple in order to research some information for her [[Sith Master/Legends|master]], [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]]. Zannah was able to fool Barra-Rona-Ban, who had become keeper of the Jedi Archives, and find the information.<ref name="RoT" /><ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Wen-Chii was a reclusive Jedi who chose to live on his homeworld for scientific studies.<ref name="RoT" /><ref name="TCSWE" /> He was also friends with fellow [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] Barra-Rona-Ban.<ref name="RoT" />

==Powers and abilities==
Wen-Chii possessed the knowledge and the skills required to become a Jedi Master.<ref name="RoT" />

==Behind the scenes==
Anno Wen-Chii was first mentioned in the [[2007]] novel ''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]'', written by [[Drew Karpyshyn]]. He later received an entry in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''.
